description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Heliod, the Warped Eclipse.
In response, cast Endless Detour by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

uses.name: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
